newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian bond tranche priced at 100.46 percent.
newsitem.headline: Russian bond tranche priced at 100.46 percent.

text.p: A new 91-day tranche of the 18-month interest-bearing OFZ government bond maturing February 26, 1997 was priced at an average 100.46 percent at auction on Wednesday, the central bank said.
Earlier tranches of the bond closed on Tuesday at 100.25
Full details of the issue follow:
Issue volume 3.00 trln rbls 3.50 trln rbls
The finance ministry is paying quarterly interest on Wednesday of 58.48 percent or 145,709 roubles per bond.
The next coupon date for the bond is the maturity date of February 26, 1997, when it will pay quarterly interest of 40.05 percent.

On Wednesday the finance ministry will also offer seven trillion roubles in six-month GKO discount Treasury bills (series 22060). It is also repaying about 4.95 trillion roubles of maturing six-month T-bills (22034) and paying total interest of about 1.05 trillion roubles on OFZ bonds (series 24003 and 24004).
